data.title: Oakley Square Residences
data.about:
Oakley Square offers a serene lifestyle within the residential development, ranging from fresh mornings to peaceful evenings. 

In a lush and natural setting, this spacious collection of studios, one and two-bedroom apartments, and penthouses await you. Designed to fit your work lifestyle, these apartments are tailored to your specific needs.

characteristics_module.title: Spacious Apartments in JVC
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Spacious Studios, one and two bedroom apartments
  • Centrally located in Jumeirah Village Circle
  • Exclusive facilities and amenities
  • Natural green spaces
  • Starting Price AED 500K
  • 70/30 payment plan

location_tile.title: Located in the heart of Dubai
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
District 11 of Jumeirah Village Circle is home to several parks and schools, as well as a variety of recreation and entertainment options. A mix of multi-family apartment buildings adds to its strategic location, making it ideal for families and residents looking for a peaceful sanctuary from the busy life and rush of the city.

  • 20 Mins – Dubai Marina
  • 20 Mins – Palm Jumeirah
  • 21 Mins – Dubai Mall
  • 38 Mins – Dubai International Airport

seo.metaTitle: Oakley Square Residences: Off-Plan Luxury Living
seo.metaDescription: Oakley Square by Ellington offers studios to 2 BR apartments and penthouses in a lush setting, designed for contemporary work-life balance.
